• Second floor: Engineering office over the business center, Purchasing office over Storage 1, a 9 × 18 m balcony.
• Slabs: GF decks 150 mm, GF slabs 100 mm, loading area 170 mm; 2nd-floor slabs 100 mm on steel deck. GF line +300 mm and decks +150 mm above the sidewalk.
